2609.24921.title: BackTrend: Evaluating Scientific Weak-Signal Prediction via Backward Reconstruction
2609.24921.paper_summary: Scientific weak signals are early, low-visibility research directions that later become central to mature scientific topics, yet existing resources such as trend tracking, citation forecasting, and foresight reports rarely provide validated reference sets that link concrete early precursors to later paradigms. We introduce BackTrend, a retrospective benchmark in which, given a mature target topic and a temporal evidence constraint, systems must recover two types of precursors: problem-space signals, underrecognized research problems, and solution-space signals, emerging methods for known problems. BackTrend contains 25 mature target topics in artificial intelligence and machine learning and 66 human-validated weak signals, reconstructed from large-scale literature by grounding each candidate in its 2019-2024 publication-frequency trajectory. We evaluate frontier LLMs, RAG systems, and agentic research systems using semantic matching and coverage-based metrics. Current systems often generate plausible but misaligned precursors, exhibiting topic drift, granularity mismatch, near-miss matching, and incomplete coverage; the strongest system achieves only 10.1% F1, while Coverage10 reaches at most 18.5% of the reference signals. Our budget analyses show that additional retrieval and web-search evidence can improve performance up to a moderate budget, but does not by itself close the substantial performance gap.
2609.24921.paper_summary_zh: 科學的弱信號是早期、低可見度的研究方向，後來成為成熟科學主題的核心，然而現有的資源如趨勢追蹤、引用預測和前瞻報告，鮮少提供經過驗證的參考集，將具體的早期前驅與後來的範式聯繫起來。我們介紹了BackTrend，一個回顧性基準，在這個基準中，給定一個成熟的目標主題和時間證據限制，系統必須恢復兩種類型的前驅：問題空間信號，即未被充分認識的研究問題，以及解決方案空間信號，即針對已知問題的新興方法。BackTrend包含25個成熟的目標主題，涵蓋人工智慧和機器學習，以及66個經人類驗證的弱信號，這些信號是從大規模文獻中重建的，並將每個候選者基於其2019-2024年的出版頻率軌跡進行定位。我們使用語義匹配和基於覆蓋率的指標來評估前沿的LLMs、RAG系統和代理研究系統。目前的系統經常生成看似合理但不對齊的前驅，表現出主題漂移、粒度不匹配、近似匹配和覆蓋不完整；最強的系統僅達到10.1%的F1，而Coverage10最多達到18.5%的參考信號。我們的預算分析顯示，額外的檢索和網絡搜索證據可以在適度預算下改善性能，但單靠這些並不能縮小顯著的性能差距。
